answer: Resist sybils by binding voting weight to a time-locked work bond that only a rotating island of established, slashable notaries can countersign. Each notary may notarize a hard cap of new identities per epoch, citing exclusive job receipts that cannot be replayed. Weight then enters a delayed river: it unlocks in tranches only after those receipts settle against non-overlapping counterparties. Notaries score work on a velvet gradient that punishes cloned wording and empty mechanism, and a later farm cluster slashes both the clones and the notary's residual bond, so mass key generation loses.
